observations: Photo 0: a cream domestic sewing machine on a tiled floor, with a black electric foot controller and cable beside it.
Photo 0: 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and 'Super Automatic' printed on the front of the arm, with a stitch-pattern window.
Photo 0: stitch-selector dials on the right panel and a small label reading 'UNTEN OBEN' (German), so it is an electric zigzag machine, not a hand or treadle machine.
Photo 0: the machine is dirty and grimy, with a pink stain on the bed and dust on the base.
Photo 0: needle plate and presser foot visible; no bobbin case, accessory box, presser feet, manual or carrying cover shown.
Photo 0: no rating plate or 'Made in Japan' marking visible.

claims.evidence: 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' printed on the arm in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows an electric machine with a foot controller and cable, and the seller also mentions a motor.
No origin marking or rating plate visible in photo 0; the panel label is in German.
No clip of it running; priced as not working until shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Only the machine and foot controller appear in photo 0; no accessory box or manual shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be shown; the grime in photo 0 suggests little maintenance.
Location cannot be confirmed from the photo.

risks.risk: Motor or foot controller may not work, or the machine may be seized from lack of servicing.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine plugged in, pressing the pedal and sewing a line of straight and zigzag stitches on fabric.

risks.risk: Timing or feed faulty so it skips stitches even if the motor runs.
risks.proof: Close-up clip of stitching on fabric showing the finished seam.

risks.risk: Bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet and manual missing.
risks.proof: One photo of all accessories and the manual laid out beside the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine and foot controller only.

risks.risk: Frayed or damaged power cable, a safety and repair cost.
risks.proof: Close-up of the full cable and plug.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a new cable.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine sewing straight and zigzag stitches on fabric with the pedal.
Photo of the accessories and manual laid out beside the machine.
Close-up of the rating plate on the back or underside.
Photo with a handwritten note bearing today's date and a code next to the machine.
response.reason: The brand and model Ideal Topstar Super Automatic are readable on the arm in photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as a dirty electric machine not proven to work, with no accessories.
